title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN – Oct. 13, Iran’s Government Spokeswoman, Fatemeh Mohajerani, held her weekly press conference today.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN – Oct. 13, Iran’s Government Spokeswoman, Fatemeh Mohajerani, held her weekly press conference today."

"SOT1, Fatemeh Mohajerani, Spokeswoman of Iran's Government (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:25): "[Regarding Iranian pilots] The Ministry of Defense and other relevant ministries, such as the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, are following up on the matter. The Qatari government has also given a favorable assurance in this regard and has always expressed its readiness to cooperate in order to clarify the situation. Therefore, we hope that the status of these dear individuals will be fully clarified as soon as possible and that, God willing, we will be able to have them among us.""

"SOT2, Fatemeh Mohajerani, Spokeswoman of Iran's Government (Farsi) (00:26 - 00:57): "The government has prepared itself for the hardest scenarios. We emphasize that all these restrictions being imposed, such as grounding flights, sanctioning our railway lines, or the speculation and rumors being raised regarding our land borders, are precisely examples of what the Islamic Republic of Iran has been declaring for years: that their target is Iran and the lives of the people.""

"SOT3, Fatemeh Mohajerani, Spokeswoman of Iran's Government (Farsi) (00:58 - 01:21): "The United States has never spoken to us so directly about the elimination of a civilization, even though this is nothing more than an illusion, meaning they will take this wish to their graves. Iranian civilization is one of the world’s great civilizations, and therefore they will take this wish to their graves, just as their predecessors did, and the same will happen now.
